name: When is it better to replace an entire drywall panel in a garage instead of patching it?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to replace an entire drywall panel in a garage instead of patching it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing an entire drywall panel is often better than patching when the damage is extensive, such as large areas of water damage, significant impact damage, or widespread mold growth. If the drywall is severely warped, structurally compromised, or has numerous small damages in one section, replacing the whole panel can be more cost-effective and provide a better, more durable finish than attempting multiple patches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace entire panels for extensive damage like widespread water damage, severe warps, or widespread mold, for better durability and finish.
